results.title: Niger declares 'severe environmental incident' after oil blowout - TRT Afrika
results.snippet:
As of Monday, "the situation is partially contained but not yet fully under control", the ministry said.

The causes of the blowout "have not been fully established" but "criminal or terrorist" involvement have been ruled out.

An investigation was underway with the help of "Algerian expertise", it added.
